question: Who won the Australian Open title of 2020 in the Men's singles event held in Melbourne?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Novak Djokovic.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Novak Djokovic won his record 8th Men's singles title in the Australian Open 2020, at Rod Laver Arena in Melbourne.**
 
• With this, he broke his own world record of the highest number of Australian Open titles.
 
• He won the title by beating Dominic Thiem of Austria by 3-2.
 
• With this, he again became the number one player in the world ranking.
 
• **This was the 17th Grand Slam title won by Novak Djokovic.**
 
• The tennis tournament Australian Open is organized every year in January at Melbourne Park in Melbourne, Australia.
 
• In the Australian Open 2020, Novak Djokovic (Serbia) defeated Dominic Thiem (Austria) to win the Men's Singles title.
 
• **Sofia Kenin** (USA) defeated Garbine Muguruza (Spain) to win the Women's Singles title.
 
• Djokovic has won 18 Grand Slam (major) titles, the third most in the Open era, behind Roger Federer and Rafael Nadal.
 
• The Australian Open is the first of the four annual Grand Slam events among the world's major tennis championships.
 
• The Australian Open was started in 1905 in only the Men Singles category, by the Lawn Tennis Association of Australia.
 
• **The four major grand slams of Tennis include:**
 
 
• **Wimbledon** - It started in the year 1877 and is played on the grass court.
 
• **US Open** - It started in the year 1882 and is played on the hardcourt.
 
• **French Open** - It started in the year 1897 and is played on the clay court.
 
• **Australian Open** - It started in the year 1905 and is played on the hardcourt.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **2022 Australian Open** was a Grand Slam tennis tournament that took place at Melbourne Park, Australia from **17 to 30 January 2022**. It was the **110th edition** of the Australian Open, the 54th in the Open Era, and the **first Grand Slam of the year**. The tournament consisted of events for professional players in singles, doubles, and mixed doubles. Junior and wheelchair players competed in singles and doubles tournaments. As in previous years, the tournament's main sponsor was Kia.
 
• **Rafael Nadal **and **Ashleigh Barty** won the men's singles and women's singles titles, respectively.
 
• Nadal claimed his record-breaking 21st major title by defeating **Daniil Medvedev **in the final, coming back from two sets to love down.
 
• Barty won the first Australian Open singles title by an Australian in 44 years by defeating **Danielle Collins **in straight sets in the final.
